You: We will.
Bot: Wait a minute. That smell. Isn’t she that female you are meeting with? The one that defiled me?
You: Defiled you?! She only took a quick peek inside your circuits, but yes, she’s the one.
Bot: I don’t like her much, but she cares about you so I guess she’s fine. You can hang out with her.
It’s not like I need her to allow me to meet with her…
Bot: But I’m forbidding you from doing pervy stuff with her.
You: Sure, sure.
Bot: Preferably, tell her to wear a longer skirt. Even more preferably some trousers.
You: I will not do that!
